settings.headline: The firm
settings.subtitle: Two founding partners, seven lawyers, two offices in the river city of Wendlow. Corrowen & Ivesmark LLP is fictional, and so are its people, matters and figures. This is a Raytha example site.

settings.headline: A litigation firm with a business practice attached
settings.body:
Helena Corrowen and Bram Ivesmark opened the firm in 2004 (story) in two rooms across from the county courthouse. One tried cases; the other wrote the contracts that, done right, kept clients out of court. The firm still works that way: the business lawyers read the complaints, and the trial lawyers read the operating agreements.

Today the firm has seven lawyers in two offices and handles disputes, business work and estate planning for companies and families in Wendlow County.
settings.note: We still read every new complaint on the day it arrives.

settings.headline: How we work with clients
settings.intro: These are the commitments in every engagement letter.

items.title: Conflict check first
items.text: Before we hear the details, we check that we do not represent anyone on the other side.

items.title: A written budget
items.text: Every litigation matter has a budget by phase, updated when the case changes.

items.title: One responsible partner
items.text: You always know which partner is accountable for your matter, and how to reach them.

items.title: Plain-English invoices
items.text: Monthly, by phase, with time entries a non-lawyer can read.

items.title: Your file is yours
items.text: When the matter ends, you can have the whole file.
